g.text: Power: USB-C -> PTC + USBLC6 -> BQ24074 (USB500: EN1=VBUS, EN2=GND) -> VSYS. TPS7A0533 (EN = power switch) -> +3V3. TPS22917 (ON = LED_EN) -> VLED.

g.text: I2C SDA P0.16 SCL P0.19 | LED ring P0.11, keys P0.05 (SPI MOSI; spare SCK pins are unconnected) | LED_EN P0.26 | BAT_SENSE P0.02 (AIN0) | CHG_N P0.23 PGOOD_N P1.03 | reset P0.18 | LFXO P0.00/P0.01

g.text: Key LED chain: keys 5-6-7-8-4-3-2-1; the back-row LEDs are turned 180 deg.

g.desc: Key LED chain: keys 5-6-7-8-4-3-2-1; the back-row LEDs are turned 180 deg.

g.text: Checked against the TI BQ24074 datasheet: ITERM and TMR open = default 10% termination and default timers (R6, R7 not fitted);

g.desc: Checked against the TI BQ24074 datasheet: ITERM and TMR open = default 10% termination and default timers (R6, R7 not fitted);

g.text: TS 10k to VSS when the cell has no NTC; EN1 high + EN2 low = 450-500 mA input; K_ISET 890 A-ohm; OUT regulates at 4.4 V.

g.desc: TS 10k to VSS when the cell has no NTC; EN1 high + EN2 low = 450-500 mA input; K_ISET 890 A-ohm; OUT regulates at 4.4 V.

g.text: 1 Battery J2 polarity must match the cell (JST-PH polarity is not standard).

g.desc: 1 Battery J2 polarity must match the cell (JST-PH polarity is not standard).

g.text: 2 OLED J5 pin order GND-VCC-SCL-SDA; header row position depends on the module drawing.

g.desc: 2 OLED J5 pin order GND-VCC-SCL-SDA; header row position depends on the module drawing.

g.text: 3 MDBT50Q-1MV2 (C5118826) was out at JLC on 23 Oct: use JLC Global Sourcing or consign it.
